findings.body:
chunk 1/2:

Raise: Security. A pull request author can edit the body to include a syntactically valid time record with `state.steps` or `clean_reviews` containing `null`. `from_body` checks that these fields are lists, then calls `row.get` without checking each entry. The resulting `AttributeError` escapes while `forge board` or `forge next` reads that PR, making those commands unavailable until the body is repaired.
findings.title: Malformed pull request records can crash board and next

findings.body:
chunk 1/2:

Raise: Functional. When a repeat close encounters a default-branch conflict, this call publishes a fabricated `reviewing` result with empty findings and empty evidence. `_publish` replaces the PR's managed block, so an existing blocked review loses its findings and proof list and instead says a review is running, although close has stopped. This occurs during normal conflict resolution on a PR that was already reviewed.
findings.title: A merge conflict replaces an existing PR's review and proof

findings.body:
chunk 1/2:

Item 12 remains incomplete here: approved but unstarted stories and GitHub-merged fixes need corrected counts; blocking plan problems are absent from Needs you; the page lacks the pinned folding sections, story keys and cold-read history; and pane times remain unrounded. The story assigns these behaviours to COUNTS, WAITS, NAV and PANE.
findings.title: Later: COUNTS, WAITS, NAV and PANE complete item 12

findings.body:
chunk 2/2:

Raise: Functional. The board passes only the story's start time and part/read intervals to `time_records.story` (board.py:605–608). For a completed story, `story()` does not extend the runway to its completion time (time_records.py:485). In a human-merge repo, an owner may record the story outcome hours after the last part merges; that elapsed time disappears from the story's unknown seconds and total. The added runway test covers only an unfinished story. This completion tail is distinct from the previously settled missing start and ongoing tails.
findings.title: Completed stories omit time after their last part merges

chunk 2/2:

Item 12 still needs the approved-but-unstarted count, blocking plan problems in Needs you, pinned folding sections with story keys and cold-read history, and rounded pane times. The board retains the old counts and card page here (board.py:662–683, 1188–1198), while the unchanged pane formatter in `src/forge/mod/hooks/summary.ts:4–6` still uses abbreviated times. The story assigns these behaviors to COUNTS, WAITS, NAV and PANE.
findings.title: Later: COUNTS, WAITS, NAV and PANE complete item 12
